Nidec expands Commander S V2 AC drive range to 11 kW

★ By Puja Mitra Leave a Comment

FacebookXLinkedInShare
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:23
Instaread

Nidec Drives, a business segment of Nidec, has expanded its Commander S V2 range of AC drives for induction motors with a new frame size that extends the range to 11 kW (15 hp). The expanded range allows customers to use the Commander S V2 platform across a broader power range and supports applications that require AC drives for induction motors.

“At Nidec Drives, we focus on creating practical solutions that help customers improve performance while reducing complexity,” said Laurent Babaud, president, Nidec Drives. “The expansion of Commander S reflects that commitment. Customers can now access higher power ratings while benefiting from the same ease of installation, reliability, and efficiency they trust today. It is another example of how we engineer solutions to solve operational challenges and deliver long-term value.”

Commander S V2 is designed for simple applications that require plug-and-play control. It is suitable for fans, pumps, compressors, conveyors and mixers.

The Commander S V2 includes the Marshal app as a standard feature. The app allows users to commission, monitor and diagnose the drive and access technical support from a smartphone.

“Customers consistently tell us they want greater capability without additional complexity,” said Roxana Suteu, product manager, Nidec Drives. “By extending Commander S to 11 kW, we’re enabling users to standardise on a single platform across more applications while benefiting from one of the smallest drive footprints available in this power range. The result is a solution that saves space, simplifies commissioning, and helps reduce installation and lifecycle costs.”

Marshal uses NFC technology to support setup with the drive powered on or off, drive cloning and real-time diagnostics. Its FastStart menu provides step-by-step guidance and reduces commissioning to four settings. The app is available for Android and iOS devices.

Commander S V2 is designed for installations where panel space is limited. Its clip-on DIN-rail mounting, compact footprint and side-by-side installation options support compact panel layouts. Laser-marked terminals and angled access points assist with wiring and installation. Conformal coating helps protect the drive from moisture, dust and corrosion and the product includes a five-year warranty. Built-in features include intelligent fan control, Modbus RTU and an integrated C1 EMC filter.

The Commander S V2 expansion provides a broader power range for applications requiring motor control. Its features support installation, commissioning, monitoring and maintenance in industrial automation and electrification systems.
